_comment: ETF rotation strategy config template. Copy to ~/.config/etf-rotation/strategy.json and customise. Any field omitted falls back to the built-in default. universe is override-by-code: adding 511260 here adds a new sleeve; specifying only {code, max_weight} for 510300 just changes that one cap.

risk_rules._comment: Portfolio-level guardrails. min_cash_weight is the floor after all other adjustments.

strategy._comment: scoring_mode: 'absolute' uses hand-tuned thresholds (legacy); 'cross_sectional' Z-scores each feature across the universe daily (self-calibrating across regimes).
strategy._policy_signal_factor: Opt-in policy_radar nudge. enabled=false by default (legacy-safe). When true, each ETF's target weight is multiplied by (1 + bullish_boost) for bullish-classified industries and (1 - bearish_penalty) for bearish-classified industries. Neutral signals pass through unchanged. Defaults are mild ±10% so the change is bounded — no position is ever zeroed or doubled by this factor alone. After per-ETF tilt the gross weight is re-normalised so the gross_cap invariant holds. Classification threshold (default ±0.10) matches the dashboard's existing bullish/bearish chip cutoffs.

etf_industry_map._comment: Map each ETF (by 6-digit code) to the policy_radar industry it belongs to. Industries must match the keys produced by policy_radar.json's signal.industry_signals (currently: 新能源汽车 / 风电 / 电网, plus whatever the active policy NLP map adds). Codes not listed here are left untouched by the policy_signal_factor. This is the only piece of config that ties opt-in policy_radar influence to your ETF universe — keep it explicit. Example: '515030': '新能源汽车' once you add an EV-themed ETF to the universe.

scoring._comment: Override only the constants you want to change; everything else falls back to EtfScoringConfig defaults.

refresh._comment: Background refresh cadence. Set enabled=true to opt in.
